name: Corteconcepción (Spain)
description: Blue field with stripes of white and yellow along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Corteconcepción (a bell, a tree and roundels on white).
history: Municipal flag of Corteconcepción; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Corteconcepción arms — bell, tree and roundels on white
